subject: RM_Bladderquill
departures: stiff translucent quills, not opaque green fleshy leaves
each quill fat and bulbous at its base, with stored water visible through the translucent wall
quills spread in a flat fan, not a radial rosette
bears bladder-fruit: swollen, liquid-filled fruit sacs
knee-high, with thin quill-like spines rather than broad blades
